method: All alphabetical pages rendered and visually opened. Independent Tesseract5 eng psm3 OCR used only as a mismatch prompt; its Chinese/IPA and Latin mistakes are not curated source facts. No machine-complete independent alphabetical set-match claimed. Main labels remain manual source transcriptions.

observed_source_differences.note: Different printed verb spellings retained literally.

source_difference_scope: Listed differences observed during review, not a guarantee that every possible difference or font/typography discrepancy was exhaustively classified. No alphabetical-only label counted as an each-unit occurrence.
